acts: AIFC Rules No. FR0001 of 2017 (General Rules)

en.title: GEN Schedule 1, paragraph 4(2): two activity names that do not exist
en.summary: Paragraph 4(2) incorporates into Managing a Collective Investment Scheme activities constituting "Dealing as Agent" and "Dealing as Principal". Schedule 1 defines "Dealing in Investments as Agent" (paragraph 2) and "Dealing in Investments as Principal" (paragraph 1); the Glossary does not define the two shorter names. The wording has been there since the initial 2017 release. The draft in Consultation Paper AFSA-PSRD-CSP-2026-0001 (Annex 2) corrects a third name in the same paragraph ("Managing Assets" to "Managing Investments") but keeps these two.
en.correction: Please use the defined names "Dealing in Investments as Agent" and "Dealing in Investments as Principal"; the change could be made in the same amendment.
